}}'''Millis Fendry''' is the innkeeper of the [[Hoop and Arrow]] in [[Caemlyn]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Millis Fendry}}

== Activities ==
Every three to four days Master [[Harnder]] visits Mistress Fendry in the Hoop and Arrow. After the visit she sends a pigeon north. She was also visited by three [[Brown Ajah]] sisters, who met with Mistress Fendry in private. [[Reene Harfor]] seems to be aware that she is a spy.
